purpose: Search for additional gauge-stable polynomial first-integral candidates on the qualified WP2-UP-v1 canonical Hamiltonian.
evidence_boundary: A no-candidate result excludes only total-degree-three-or-less polynomials in the 14 dimensionless canonical upstairs variables on the frozen development/calibration corpus, gauges, and thresholds. A numerical candidate is not a conserved quantity and only triggers a separately frozen candidate-specific qualification. This campaign cannot open the sealed publication reserve and cannot authorize a WP4 or integrability claim.

staged_policy.SEARCH_READY: Requires both prerequisite locks and records, an intact pre-search lock, an intact sealed reserve commitment, and passing known controls.
staged_policy.CANDIDATE_READY: Requires every frozen train/calibration/family/gauge threshold. No interpretation is authorized.
staged_policy.SEALED_QUALIFICATION: Can be triggered only by CANDIDATE_READY=PASS under a new candidate-specific lock.
staged_policy.WP4_READY: Can be triggered only by a passing candidate-specific sealed qualification and independent replication.
